title: Boston Gas Company files a 365 Day Transportation Agreement with Northeastern University.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The pricing structure is in accordance with the Department's standard and the Department, therefore, APPROVES the Company's proposed transportation service. The Department also finds that the pricing terms under the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore, GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Janet Gail Besser, Chair; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr.
